basic_profile.bio: Avid hiker and climbing enthusiast living in Southern California. I spend a lot of my weekends exploring new trails and climbing spots around SoCal. By day, I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to work from anywhere with a WiFi connection. I'm passionate about sustainability and often participate in local environmental clean-up events. Despite my adventurous lifestyle, I enjoy cozy evenings playing Fallout 4 or indulging in nostalgia for discontinued fast-food items. Currently single, I embrace a polyamorous lifestyle, valuing connections and experiences with multiple partners. I'm usually online during late evenings, often after a day's hike or climb.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Possess a deep understanding of graphic design, acquired through a Bachelor of Arts degree and several years of freelance work. Over the years, I've also developed a keen interest in outdoor activities, learning through community events and personal experience. Additionally, I have a moderate understanding of gaming culture, especially related to the Fallout series.
